title: Requirements for Baptism
summary: Moroni describes the qualifications for those who were baptized: repentance, a broken heart and contrite spirit, a witness of repentance, and determination to serve Christ.

explicit_facts.text: Elders, priests, and teachers were baptized only when they brought forth fruit showing they were worthy.
People were received unto baptism only if they came with a broken heart and contrite spirit and witnessed to the church that they truly repented of their sins.
Those received unto baptism took upon themselves the name of Christ and determined to serve him to the end.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The passage can be conveyed through off-screen narration over a baptismal setting; no individual baptism is explicitly narrated.
unspecified_visual_details: The people’s identities and appearances, the baptismal setting, and the manner of baptism are unspecified.

narration.text: Behold, elders, priests, and teachers were baptized
a broken heart and a contrite spirit
a determination to serve him to the end.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: These verses state requirements for baptism; they do not describe a specific baptismal event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict a specific baptism as occurring in the present scene.

title: Received and Nourished in the Church
summary: After baptism, people were cleansed by the power of the Holy Ghost, numbered among the church, and recorded so they could be remembered and nourished.

explicit_facts.text: After baptism, people were wrought upon and cleansed by the power of the Holy Ghost and numbered among the people of the church of Christ.
Their names were taken so they might be remembered and nourished by the word of God, kept in the right way, and watchful unto prayer.
They relied alone upon the merits of Christ, described as the author and finisher of their faith.

reasonable_visual_inferences: A written record of names may be shown as a visual illustration of the names being taken.
unspecified_visual_details: The people, recorder, record, and place are not individually described.
No visible manifestation or appearance of the Holy Ghost is specified.

narration.text: they were numbered among the people of the church of Christ

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The cleansing and guidance are stated as spiritual claims, not as a described visible manifestation.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict a visible form of the Holy Ghost or Christ.
Do not invent specific people, spoken words, or a particular record-keeping ceremony.

title: Frequent Meetings
summary: The church met often to fast, pray, discuss the welfare of their souls, and partake of bread and wine in remembrance of the Lord Jesus.

explicit_facts.text: The church met together often to fast, pray, and speak with one another concerning the welfare of their souls.
They often met to partake of bread and wine in remembrance of the Lord Jesus.

reasonable_visual_inferences: A gathered congregation and bread and wine can illustrate the stated meetings.
unspecified_visual_details: The participants’ identities, appearance, number, and meeting place are unspecified.

narration.text: to partake of bread and wine

doctrinal_or_story_notes: These verses summarize recurring meetings rather than narrating one particular meeting.
prohibited_inventions: Do not combine the distinct stated activities into a specifically narrated ceremony.
Do not add a spoken prayer, sermon, or dialogue.

title: Discipline and Repentance
summary: They were strict about iniquity among them. The verses describe a conditional process involving three witnesses and the elders: those who did not repent and confess were no longer numbered among the people of Christ. Those who repented and sought forgiveness with real intent were forgiven.

explicit_facts.text: They were strict to observe that there should be no iniquity among them.
The described process applies to whoso was found to commit iniquity and was condemned by three witnesses of the church before the elders.
If they did not repent and confess, their names were blotted out and they were not numbered among the people of Christ.
As often as they repented and sought forgiveness with real intent, they were forgiven.

unspecified_visual_details: No particular case, person's identity, offense, location, or appearance is specified.
The manner of blotting out names is unspecified.

narration.text: And they were strict to observe that there should be no iniquity among them;
and if they repented not, and confessed not, their names were blotted out
But as oft as they repented and sought forgiveness, with real intent, they were forgiven.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The verses describe a general practice and principle, not a particular disciplinary encounter.
prohibited_inventions: Do not stage a specific hearing or invent an offender, offense, confession, or spoken exchange.
Do not depict removal and forgiveness as simultaneous events involving one particular person.

title: Meetings Led by the Spirit
summary: Church meetings were conducted according to the workings of the Spirit: they preached, exhorted, prayed, supplicated, or sang as the Holy Ghost led them.

explicit_facts.text: The church conducted its meetings after the manner of the workings of the Spirit and by the power of the Holy Ghost.
As the power of the Holy Ghost led them to preach, exhort, pray, supplicate, or sing, so they did.

reasonable_visual_inferences: A congregation gathered in a meeting can illustrate the teaching; the listed forms of worship need not be depicted as occurring simultaneously.
unspecified_visual_details: The specific meeting, participants, setting, and which activity occurred on any occasion are unspecified.

or to supplicate, or to sing

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The Holy Ghost’s leading is described as spiritual guidance; no visible appearance is stated.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the Holy Ghost as a visible person or force.
